description: Breakdown of an INDICATOR: a component, a maturity, a survey question, a forecasting institution. _Z where the indicator has no breakdown, _T for the total of one.

The silver series an observation is built from, as <structure ID>/<series key>, e.g. ESTAT:NAMQ_10_GDP(1.0)/Q.CLV10_MEUR.SCA.B1GQ.AT. Several inputs are joined by a space and a plus sign, in the order the transformation names them.
Edition of a forecast publication the observation is taken from, as the publisher names it, e.g. 2026-11 or EO118.
Structure ID and key of the series FRED mirrors, where it mirrors one, e.g. OECD.SDD.STES:DSD_KEI@DF_KEI(4.0)/AUT.M.IRLT.PA._Z._Z._Z.
Survey of the EC Business and Consumer Surveys programme, or the composite indicator built from several, as the first segment of the Commission's series code.
Question number as the survey's questionnaire numbers it.
Answer category, or the balance of answers (BS), as the Commission's series code has it.
Data set of the OeNB web service, the id argument of oenb.data().
Position code of a series within an OeNB data set, the pos argument of oenb.data(); hyphens become underscores in the code and the OeNB's spelling is kept as the code's source_code.
The attribute dimensions the OeNB reports for a series, as name=value pairs joined by semicolons in the order attr1 to attrN, e.g. PRODUZENT=AT;BANKENSEKTOR=00100SK;REGION=AT;WAEHRUNG=Z0Z.
Instrument as Yahoo Finance names it; the code drops characters SDMX does not allow in an ID (^ATX becomes ATX) and keeps Yahoo's symbol as its source_code.
Which price of the period the value is.
Place a weather series was requested for.
Latitude in decimal degrees the value was requested for.
Longitude in decimal degrees the value was requested for.
Index of the Caldara-Iacoviello data set as its workbook names it.
Whether the dummy marks the period a measure is in force (step) or the period it happened (impulse).
